mentions.name: Food Sharing Platform
mentions.description: A food sharing platform that works with partner restaurants to collect and distribute food donations; it has been running since the pandemic and relies on outreach to recruit more restaurant partners.
mentions.problem: Acquiring more partner restaurants is a thankless job, and food donations tend to be clustered in particular areas.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on my food sharing platform since the pandemic. However, acquiring more partner restaurants is a thankless job and food donations tend to be clustered in particular areas.
